commands.description: Offline independent evaluation of unchanged first raw observations, not hardware execution. Evaluate original SDK log, complete images and health; preserve failure and missing physical criteria.

artifacts.description: Actual native timing and retained-state result

criteria.description: Reset/release to fresh App RTT signature <=1500ms; preserve interval and debugger overhead.
criteria.dependency_rationale: Bound production executable plus native capture/evaluation tooling and unchanged P1-7 requirements.

gate.rationale: Unchanged P1-7 task gate, not fitted to a measurement; conservative observation upper bound.

criteria.description: After Boot latches PD2 high, no sampled low through App startup; preserve sample resolution.
criteria.dependency_rationale: Bound production executable plus native capture/evaluation tooling and unchanged P1-7 requirements.

criteria.description: Physical recovery predicate requires continuous key hold >=3s, rejects a short hold, and Boot 1000ms delay remains a real second. Startup/tick sampling alone cannot PASS this combined criterion.
criteria.dependency_rationale: Bound production executable plus native capture/evaluation tooling and unchanged P1-7 requirements.

criteria.description: Boot-phase clock registers resolve 288MHz and bound Boot executable <=65536 bytes.
criteria.dependency_rationale: Bound production executable plus native capture/evaluation tooling and unchanged P1-7 requirements.

criteria.description: With USB and J-Link disconnected, battery-only physical power-button startup enters App. External-supply startup cannot PASS this criterion.
criteria.dependency_rationale: Bound production executable plus native capture/evaluation tooling and unchanged P1-7 requirements.
